newsitem.title: USA: First Union to focus on parking industry.
newsitem.headline: First Union to focus on parking industry.

text.p: First Union Real Estate Investments said Friday it plans to make the parking industry "a primary focus" and has hired Prudential Securities as an adviser to pursue acquisitions of parking properties.
First Union said it currently owns and operates three parking facilities, which account for 3.0 percent of its assets and 7.0 percent of its operating income.
The company, a real estate investment trust, has more than $800 million in assets under its control.

James Mastandrea, chairman and chief executive, said First Union is "committed to making the acquisition of parking assets a primary focus," and plans to make parking a significant portion of the company's portfolio.

First Union is looking at several potential acquisitions, he said, adding that, with the company's recent restructuring and equity offerings, it is competitively positioned to go to the capital markets to fund its acquisition program.
